heroHeadline: SSC Detains Three Anti-Unión Suspects in Tepito Killings as Yellow-Alert Rains and a Metro Line 12 Fault Round Out the Week
heroSubtitle: The Secretaría de Seguridad Ciudadana detained three alleged Anti-Unión members in the Morelos neighborhood on September 17, seizing two firearms and roughly 300 doses of narcotics, tied to the September 16 killing of Odette Rosas, 18, and Abigail Herrera, 19, in the ongoing Centro Histórico turf war. The city then absorbed two infrastructure jolts: a September 19–20 Yellow Alert brought heavy rain to nine boroughs, felling eight trees including an 18-meter tree that damaged a bus canopy in Iztapalapa, and a September 23 track-zone fault between Mixcoac and Tláhuac forced Metro Line 12 into hours of slow-speed running with waits over 40 minutes during peak commute.
